spr.note: Figures approximate India's ISPRL Strategic Petroleum Reserve public disclosures (Vizag, Mangalore, Padur caverns).

national.note: gdp_elasticity_to_10usd_oil_shock: approximate historical relationship cited in multiple IMF/RBI studies -- a sustained $10/bbl rise in crude is associated with roughly 0.2-0.3 percentage point drag on India's GDP growth. Used here as an explicit, adjustable coefficient, not a black-box output.
